key.name: window-width
key.description: Width of the main window in pixels. The application saves it when the window closes.

key.name: window-height
key.description: Height of the main window in pixels. The application saves it when the window closes.

key.name: window-maximized
key.description: Set to true if the main window was maximized when it closed.

key.name: volume
key.description: Volume of the last session. Use 0.0 for silence and 1.0 for full volume.

key.name: quit-on-close
key.description: If true, the application stops when the user closes the window. If false, it continues to play in the background.

key.name: show-notifications
key.description: If true, the application shows a notification when the track changes while the window is closed.

key.name: check-updates
key.description: If true, the application checks for a new version at start-up.

key.name: last-update-check
key.summary: Time of the last update check
key.description: Unix time, in seconds, of the last update check. The value 0 means that no check was done.

key.name: api-cache-max-mb
key.summary: Size limit of the API cache
key.description: Maximum size of the cache for API responses, in mebibytes. The application removes the oldest entries when the cache is larger.
